CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION pilot_private.record_admission()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$begin
 insert into pilot_private.admissions(order_id,customer_id,store_id)values(new.id,new.customer_id,new.store_id);return new;end $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.trg_dispatch()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
begin
  if new.status = 'preparing' and old.status is distinct from 'preparing' and new.driver_id is null then
    perform dispatch_next(new.id);
  elsif new.status in ('rejected', 'cancelled', 'delivered') then
    update order_offers set state = 'cancelled' where order_id = new.id and state = 'pending';
  end if;
  return new;
end $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION finance_private.guard_cash_allocation()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'public'
AS $function$
begin
 if tg_op='INSERT' then
  if new.cash_allocation_version is not null or new.cash_platform_share is not null or new.cash_driver_delivery_share is not null or new.cash_allocation_reference is not null then raise exception 'cash_allocation_immutable'; end if;
 elsif row(new.cash_allocation_version,new.cash_platform_share,new.cash_driver_delivery_share,new.cash_allocation_reference)
 is distinct from row(old.cash_allocation_version,old.cash_platform_share,old.cash_driver_delivery_share,old.cash_allocation_reference) then
  if old.cash_allocation_version is not null or coalesce(current_setting('talabot.cash_snapshot',true),'')<>old.id::text then raise exception 'cash_allocation_immutable'; end if;
 end if;
 return new;
end $function$
